refnamediv.refpurpose: Type representing a syntax tree node

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: A SilikoNode represents a node in a syntax tree generated by a parser, such as the SilikoParseInfix function. It can represent a leaf node, which holds a single value; a branch node, which represents a function call or operation, and has child nodes representing the function parameters or operands; or nothing, representing a signal from a parser component that it has found nothing matching its rule, but it is not an error.
